name: CMD-1
notes: CMD-1 is an addition to the brief; the CMD collaboration site dates it. The one-line history gives no physics results, so the record rests on the collaboration page only.

summary.plain: The first Cryogenic Magnetic Detector at the Budker Institute's VEPP-2M collider in Novosibirsk, which took data from 1979 to 1984. It began the CMD line of detectors (CMD-2, CMD-3) run by one collaboration.
summary.technical: CMD-1: first detector of the CMD (Cryogenic Magnetic Detector) collaboration, experiments 1979-1984 at VEPP-2M (the web site says 'VEPP-2'); followed by CMD-2 (commissioning 1984-1992) and CMD-3.
